page.overview:
Who is Lazeus?

Captain Lazeus was the captain of the Hephaestus.

Lazeus was a respected captain who was known to treat his crew well, including the suboids. He was killed when the Hephaestus crashlanded on Arrakis.

Suph Rondi was approached by the Prisoner on the wreck of the Hephaestus. He told them of Lazeus' popularity and his death in the crash.
